watches.name: Fortitude GMT - Nighthawk
watches.description: One glance at the Fortitude GMT and you'll know why it's the pilot's watch. Featuring a jet turbine inspired bezel, signature hands & indexes, a sandwich dial with generous lume, and an extra-large crown, whether you're in the cockpit, jump seat or backseat, you'll always know when it's time for take-off. Prioritizing legibility, the custom handset for ‘local time’ and a prominent ‘home time’ hand ensures you'll never lose a minute crossing borders or timezones.

specsRaw.Pro Tip: The Fortitude GMT is protected from scratches and scrapes by UltraHex™ and with 100m of water resistance, it's pool adventure approved. Don't forget to pack your swim gear and a HexaFlex strap!

watches.name: RESOLUTE - Spruce Green
watches.description: Project Forest Special Edition Celebrating five years of adventures, the enamel dial Resolutes are the most refined iteration of our titanium field watch that started it all. Crafted from ultra-durable, lightweight titanium, beautifully brushed and coated with our proprietary UltraHex™️, the Resolute features an upgraded bracelet with 'on-the-fly' micro adjustment and a breathtaking black enamel dial. Adding interest and depth, you'll be mesmerized by the applied logo and polish on the handset and indices, bringing an elevated level of craftsmanship to a tough titanium tool watch. The Spruce Green Special Edition nods to the White Spruce that makes up a portion of the forests in interior British Columbia and Alberta. In RZE's pursuit of being carbon negative, we developed a partnership with Project Forest whose mission is to capture carbon in the most efficient way possible - by rewilding Canada’s backyards. 15% of each sale is dedicated to supporting Project Forest's work with the community and Indigenous leaders of Cumberland House Cree Nation, to restore traditional land use and reestablish food bearing and culturally significant plants. You can learn more about the Food and Medicine Forest project here . Although not limited in number, each special edition will include a case-back engraving dedicated to Project Forest alongside a patch to signify the trees and shrubs that were planted on your behalf.
